info.title: Administration Stack API
info.description: Odoo/staff-app/client-app contract for the Trial Org and Client Org record of truth (docs/adr/0034, docs/adr/0036).

orgToken.description: Opaque per-org token issued at provision time (docs/adr/0036). Scoped to exactly one org.

sigv4.name: Authorization
sigv4.description: AWS SigV4 (docs/adr/0036), verified at the front door before the request reaches this service - not a literal API key. Modeled as apiKey here because OpenAPI 3.0 has no native SigV4 scheme.

OrgId.description: The Administration Stack's own identifier for a Trial Org or Client Org.

OrgType.description: Trial Org: the ephemeral evaluation offering. Client Org: a stable hosted org for a paying client. See docs/contexts/hosting/CONTEXT.md.

SeatsTotal.description: Number of seats issued for this org, 1-25 (system-wide ceiling, matching hosting_admin's SYSTEM_WIDE_SEAT_CAP).

expiryDate.description: Absent for a Client Org, which has no Auto-Destroy expiry.

code.description: Stack-specific machine-readable error code, stable across `detail` wording changes.

expiryDate.description: Absent for a Client Org, which has no Auto-Destroy expiry.

lastJobStatus.description: That job's own outcome (#281) - settled by check-status (#298) once the underlying execution reaches a terminal status.

lastJobError.description: A clear, actionable reason for lastJobStatus's most recent 'failed' outcome; blank whenever the last observed outcome wasn't a failure.

lastActivityAt.description: Set to the moment the org reaches active (issue or wake) - what the idle-suspend sweep (#282) checks against the idle timeout.

snapshotRetentionUntil.description: Set on every destroy, whether triggered by the auto-destroy sweep (#282) or a manual destroy call.

allOf.description: Defaults to a slugified `name` when omitted.
null for the Unattributed bucket - see docs/adr/0030.

SpendByType.description: Spend split by org type (this ticket's User Stories, #3/#4: "the cost of selling separately from the cost of serving"). unattributed carries both AWS's own Unattributed bucket and any tagged spend whose org record no longer exists.

snapshotDate.description: ISO date this snapshot was refreshed for (this ticket's User Stories, #12: "know the figures' as-of time").

daysRemainingOnCreditKnown.description: false when burnRatePerDay is 0 - daysRemainingOnCredit is then meaningless, not a real projection.

forecastExhaustionDate.description: The state-aware projection's forecast credit-exhaustion date, or null if it never exhausts within the simulation horizon.

invitedBySeatId.description: Absent for a Seat created via an Open Invite Link join, which is confirmed by domain match rather than vouched for by an existing member.

get.description: docs/contexts/hosting/CONTEXT.md: "the read-only summary of an org's own standing". The org token must scope to {orgId} itself (docs/adr/0036) - any other {orgId} is 403.

get.description: Reads the latest cost dashboard snapshot (this ticket, #198) - never refreshes on open (docs/adr/0030: the dashboard reads whatever the last daily refresh produced, with no AWS round-trip on open).

post.description: Production entry point for the daily cost-dashboard refresh (this ticket, #198): reachable by an external scheduler on a recurring (daily) cadence, mirroring the sweep routes' own "batch job behind an idempotent admin route" shape. Also evaluates and publishes any newly crossed spend-threshold or exhaustion-horizon alert on the same call.

post.summary: Auto-Destroy every active or suspended Trial Org past its expiry date
post.description: Production entry point for the auto-destroy sweep (#282): reachable by an external scheduler on a recurring cadence. A Client Org is never selected, regardless of any date field it carries; an issued (never provisioned) Trial Org is ignored. Every destroy leaves the org with a snapshot-retention marker set.

400.description: Malformed request body, or a malformed invite email

403.description: Org token does not scope to this org, is not Seat-scoped, the inviting Seat has not accepted yet, or the invite email is cross-domain

post.summary: Request a passwordless sign-in link for an org (#200 User Stories 4, 6, 12)
post.description: Qualifies identically to the invitation paths it fronts (ADR-0026): an email with an existing Seat always qualifies; an email with none only qualifies on an org that accepts Open Invite joins - either way the email must match the org's prospect domain. Always 202 with no body: this never reveals whether a given email actually has a Seat.

202.description: Accepted - a magic link was sent if the email qualifies

400.description: Malformed request body, or a malformed email

403.description: The email does not match this org's prospect domain

post.summary: Exchange a magic-link token for an org token (#200 User Stories 12, 13)
post.description: Single-use and time-boxed (docs/adr, this ticket): an expired, already-used, or unknown token is 404, never revealing which.

404.description: The token is unknown, already used, or expired

409.description: The org has no remaining seats (an Open Invite Link filled up between request and verify), or an Idempotency-Key conflict

schema.description: Seconds to wait before retrying - only set when the 409 is an Idempotency-Key still-processing conflict.

get.summary: Resolve a Host's dnsSubdomainLabel to the org it belongs to (no auth - the asleep page's own entry point)
get.description: Reachable by any visitor: this is the only lookup a suspended org's own Route53 failover (ADR-0030) can make, since the visitor carries no org id or token at all. Exposes nothing beyond orgId/name - never seats, domain, or state.

get.summary: Poll the asleep/Wake-Up page's own phase (no auth)
get.description: Visiting this never itself wakes the org (#200: "Wake stays explicit") - it only reports the current phase.

post.summary: Wake a suspended org (no auth - the asleep page's own Wake Up button)
post.description: A no-op (not an error) if the org is not currently suspended - a slow double-click or a second open tab racing this one is ordinary. Rate limited per org, not per IP (#200's Further Notes: "a link shared in a group chat has many IPs"), since this is the one public action that starts real compute.
